title: Optimizing Writing Skills through Problem-Based Learning and Scrablle Media in Elementary Schools
text_snippet: Optimizing Writing Skills through Problem-Based Learning and Scrablle Media in Elementary Schools Maharah kitabah (writing skills) is an important component in Arabic language learning that requires an innovative approach. This study aims to analyze the effectiveness of using the Problem Based Learning (PBL) model and scrabble media in improving Arabic writing skills of students at SDIT Al Hidayah Palembang. This study uses a combination research method (mix method) with a sequential explanatory model, involving 23 fifth grade students who became the experimental class. The research instruments include observation, interviews, documentation, pre-test and post-test. The results showed that the application of PBL and scrabble media significantly improved Arabic writing skills, with an average increase in post-test scores reaching 85.87 compared to the average pre-test of only 65.00. The findings of the study revealed that the combination of the PBL model and scrabble media was effective in optimizing maharah kitabah, increasing active participation, learning motivation, and students' creativity in writing Arabic. This study provides theoretical and practical contributions to the development of innovative and interactive Arabic language learning strategies.

title: The Effect of Web-Based Puzzle Media on Enhancing Arabic Reading Comprehension Among Students at Madrasah Tsanawiyah
text_snippet: The Effect of Web-Based Puzzle Media on Enhancing Arabic Reading Comprehension Among Students at Madrasah Tsanawiyah This study aims to test the effect of using web-based Puzzle media on improving Arabic reading comprehension of class VIII students of MTs Nurul Ikhsan Cirebon. Puzzle media is designed to increase student involvement in learning Arabic interactively and enjoyably. This study uses an experimental method with a one group pretest posttest design. The application of this media is recommended as one of the innovations in Arabic language learning to significantly improve students' reading skills. This study contributes to the development of technology- based learning media that supports the teaching and learning process in the digital era. The results of data analysis show a significant effect of using web-based Puzzle media on students' Arabic reading comprehension. Based on the results of the t-test, the calculated t value was 14.9> t table of 2.084 at a significance level of 0.05. Then there is a difference after being given treatment of 35.33 which was previously 43.84 to 79.17. This indicates that the application of this media can effectively improve students' reading comprehension.

title: Integration of Empiricism, Rationalism, and Postivism in Arabic Language Teaching: a Philosophy of Education Approach
text_snippet: Integration of Empiricism, Rationalism, and Postivism in Arabic Language Teaching: a Philosophy of Education Approach This study examines the integration of three philosophical schools—empiricism, rationalism, and positivism—in Arabic language teaching to develop a holistic and effective pedagogical approach. The scope of the study includes an analysis of the contributions of each philosophical school to Arabic language education, which has traditionally been fragmented in its application. Empiricism emphasizes sensory experience (John Locke), rationalism focuses on logical reasoning (René Descartes), and positivism prioritizes objective verification (Auguste Comte). The research aims to formulate an Arabic teaching model that integrates these three paradigms, ensuring that learning is both theoretically grounded and practically applicable. The methodology employed is library research, involving the analysis of written sources such as philosophical works, academic journals, and relevant books. The findings reveal that integrating these three philosophical approaches can create a balanced teaching framework. title: Availability and Adequacy of ICT Tools for Teaching Arabic in Colleges of Education, North-central Nigeria
text_snippet: Availability and Adequacy of ICT Tools for Teaching Arabic in Colleges of Education, North-central Nigeria ABSTRACTArabic language is used to access information on the Internet, just like other languages. Its teaching-learning could be enhanced through the use of Information and Communication Technology tools. The inadequate availability as well as the lackadaisical attitude of some teachers to the use of ICT tools in some educational institutions are reported in some works. This study aimed at investigating the level of availability and adequacy of ICT tools for teaching Arabic Language in Colleges of Education in North-central, Nigeria. This study was a descriptive survey research type. The target population and sample consisted of all the 75 lecturers of Arabic in the 15 Colleges of Education in the North-central. The study sample was purposively drawn from the colleges where Arabic was taught. A researcher-developed questionnaire with reliability index of 0.78 was used for data collection. The percentage, One-way Analysis of Variance and the t-test were used for data analysis at 0.05 level of significance. title: Project-Based Learning (PBL) Method in Arabic Language Learning to Develop Students' Literacy Skills
text_snippet: Project-Based Learning (PBL) Method in Arabic Language Learning to Develop Students' Literacy Skills This study aims to analyze the application of the Project-Based Learning (PBL) method in Arabic language learning to develop students' literacy skills. PBL is applied as an innovative approach that encourages students to actively learn through relevant and contextual projects. This study uses a qualitative method with data collection techniques in the form of observation, interviews, and documentation. The results of the study indicate that the application of PBL improves literacy skills, such as reading, writing, speaking, and listening in Arabic while motivating students to learn collaboratively and creatively. PBL also helps students develop 21st-century skills, such as problem-solving and critical thinking. However, this study has limitations in terms of sample coverage and duration of implementation. Therefore, further research is recommended to expand the scope and explore the integration of technology in PBL. The contribution of this study is to provide new insights into the application of PBL in the context of Arabic language learning to improve students' literacy skills as a whole.

text_snippet: Development of KineMaster Application as ICT-Based Arabic Learning Media KineMaster is a software that can be used to create multimedia and e-learning based Arabic learning media. The advantage of this software is that it can produce interesting video presentations and animations and how to use it is very easy. The purpose of this research is to introduce ICT (Information and Communication Technology)-based learning methods to learning Arabic using the KineMaster application. The method used is ADDIE as the development of learning materials and training soft skills. The result of this research is that teachers can utilize technology as a support for Arabic learning media and increase students' learning interest. Thus, the application of the KineMaster application can be used as an alternative in developing innovative and creative Arabic learning media.

title: Utilizing Interactive Media to Enhance Arabic Literacy in Secondary School Students
text_snippet: Utilizing Interactive Media to Enhance Arabic Literacy in Secondary School Students This study aims to explore the application of interactive media in improving Arabic literacy in secondary school students, focusing on the use of digital platforms and immersive technologies such as AR/VR. The research method used is a descriptive approach with qualitative analysis. The main findings indicate that the use of interactive media has a positive impact on improving students' understanding of Arabic vocabulary, grammar, and cultural context. However, challenges such as limited access to adequate technology and lack of training for teachers in integrating this technology into learning are still obstacles. This study also identified differences in students' comfort levels with technology, which affect the effectiveness of learning. Based on these findings, this study recommends increasing access to technology in schools, further training for teachers, and developing a curriculum that is more integrated with digital media. With these steps, it is hoped that Arabic language learning can be more effective and relevant to the needs of the digital era

text_snippet: Development Quizizz Application As Instrument Evaluation in Arabic Language Learning for Class X at MAN 2 Mataram This study aims to develop a Quizizz-based evaluation instrument for Arabic language learning at the Madrasah Aliyah level using the ADDIE development model. The research process includes needs analysis, question design according to the curriculum, development through expert validation, trial implementation, and evaluation. Validation from content and media experts indicates a very high level of product validity, while assessments from teachers and students deem the product highly practical and usable without revision. The survey analysis results show that the Quizizz application facilitates the evaluation process with its practicality and interactivity. Constraints include technological and resource limitations, while supporting factors include ease of use and evaluation of effectiveness.

However, weaknesses in the provision of teaching materials and less focus on language fluency are challenges that need to be overcome. Opportunities to become a leading course institution are increasingly open with the increasing public interest in learning Arabic, while threats from fierce competition and dwindling teaching tutors require proactive strategies to ensure program sustainability. title: Measuring Arabic Reading Skills of New Students in Islamic Senior High School at Pandemic Era
text_snippet: Measuring Arabic Reading Skills of New Students in Islamic Senior High School at Pandemic Era The Senior High School (SMA) period is a significant transitional period for some youth in Indonesia. This condition is a challenge for teachers, especially in teaching Arabic language skills, including reading skills of the Qur'an. The Qur'an is a holy book that contains a collection of information from God. Therefore, learning the skills to read the Qur'an is very important, especially for Muslim students. This article is a descriptive qualitative research type that aims to describe the techniques and results of observations of the academic abilities of new students at MAN 4 Banyuwangi in the academic year 2020/2021 in terms of reading Arabic texts namely the Qur'an. The results of this study indicate that: 1) the technique used to measure the academic ability is the performance test of reading the Qur'an, Surat al-Mujadilah verses 11-13, and 2) based on the test results, out of 118 students, a total of 54% or 64 students have high academic abilities and total of 46% or 54 students have low academic abilities. It shows that academic ability of Arabic reading skills in MAN 4 Banyuwangi need to be corrected and developed to get higher score.
